statement: For every n ≥ 1 and every component array α, the measure Sα n,N is nonnegative. There is a constant C, independent of N ≥ K0, the axis torus in the exhaustion of Section 8, and the positions of the unit boxes, such that Sα n,N (Q1 × · · · × Qn) ≤ Cn n! (10.3) for all unit boxes Q1, . . . , Qn. The same bound holds in the periodic infinite-plane state. For each fixed number D of terminal cells, their component field sums have joint exponential moments in a neighborhood of the origin, uniformly in these cutoffs and axis tori. If µ is the source-free terminal probability law and zY ∈ C3 is supported on at most D terminal sites with |zα Y | ≤ 1, their generating function differs from Eµ exp X Y zY · VY ! (10.4) by oH(1), uniformly for fixed D. 82 On each fixed tilted physical torus of Section 8, the exponential-moment bounds and Equa- tion (10.3) hold with constants that may depend on that torus and on H, but remain independent of N.
